title: fix(turning): Facing, Profile Rough and Profile Finish take a start and an exit pick
body:
Slice 1 of #3331: Facing, Profile Rough and Profile Finish. This PR does not close the issue. The eight other turning kinds are the next slices.

## What changed

- A turning pick is a point in the lathe (Z, X) plane. It is a model point `[x, y, z]`. The planner reads it as (station, radius) about the fitted turning axis.
- Start: one rapid goes from the opening point of the path to the pick. The first feed starts at the pick and ends where it ended before.
- Exit: one feed goes from the end of the last feed to the pick. One rapid goes from the pick to the old end point of the path.
- The moves between the first feed and the last feed do not change.
- New module `crates/motion/src/turning/start_exit.rs` (`with_picks`, `PickLaw`). It works on the finished path of a kernel. The kernels do not change.
- The registry has a new capability, `PickCapability::Meridian`, for the three kinds.
- Threading says "not taken" with its own reason: "the thread start law sets the start and the exit of a thread". The G76 start judge does not change.
- MCP: the `edit_operation` schema names the three kinds and says that z is necessary. `list_operation_types` gives `start_exit.plane` for them.
- UI: the Geometry tab of the three kinds has a Start point group and an Exit point group. The rows are typed (Z and X). Apply uses `EditOperationParams`.

A pick is refused by name, and is never moved, when one of these is true:

- The pick has no Z (refused at the command door, with the name of the kind).
- The pick is not in air: it is inside the stock radius and behind the free end, each grown by the nose radius.
- The pick is on the chuck side of the bar.
- The rapid to the start, or the rapid from the exit, crosses the stock envelope.
- The feed between the pick and the cut comes nearer to the part than nose radius + stock to leave - tolerance.
- The exit feed runs along the surface that the last pass cut.
- The path has canned cycles or control compensation.

## Cause

The turning kinds had the `picks` field of #3339, but no planner read it. The registry gave each turning kind the "owed" reason, so the command door refused each pick.

## Where the issue is silent

- The issue does not say how the tool gets from the pick to the first pass. I chose the smallest change: the first feed of the kernel starts at the pick. The kernel ladder does not change.
- The issue does not say which stock a rapid must miss. I chose the envelope of the part and the setup stock. It does not follow stock that earlier operations removed. This is the safe side.
- The issue does not ask for a viewport pick. A turning point is in air, so the wall snap of the 2D Contour pick is not correct for it. The rows are typed.
- The decision file is `docs/decisions/3331-turning-start-exit.md`.

## Tests

Pins (all on the final head `255413391`):

- `crates/app/tests/start_exit_shared/turning.rs` (8 tests, in the existing `start_exit_shared` binary):
  - `the_first_pass_starts_at_the_start_pick`
  - `the_last_pass_leaves_at_the_exit_pick`
  - `a_start_and_an_exit_pick_hold_together`
  - `an_impossible_pick_is_refused_by_name`
  - `a_pick_whose_move_crosses_the_part_or_the_stock_is_refused_by_name`
  - `threading_keeps_its_start_law_and_says_so_by_name`
  - `undo_and_redo_restore_the_path`
  - `mcp_edit_operation_sets_the_turning_picks_and_undo_clears_them`
- `crates/motion/src/turning/start_exit_tests.rs` (8 unit tests, `turning::start_exit::tests::*`).
- `crates/ui/src/egui_app/turning_start_exit_tests.rs` (4 tests, `egui_app::turning_start_exit_rows::tests::*`).
- `every_kind_has_one_pick_capability_and_only_the_taken_ones_take_a_pick` now includes the new capability (an expected change of a pinned list).

Pin proof (the guard was removed, the pin was run, the guard was put back):

| Guard removed | Result | Red test |
|---|---|---|
| `generate.rs` of `upstream/main` (no pick laid) | red | 6 of the 8 app tests: `the_first_pass_starts_at_the_start_pick`, `the_last_pass_leaves_at_the_exit_pick`, `a_start_and_an_exit_pick_hold_together`, `an_impossible_pick_is_refused_by_name`, `a_pick_whose_move_crosses_the_part_or_the_stock_is_refused_by_name`, `undo_and_redo_restore_the_path` |
| the "needs a Z" door in `pick_kinds.rs` | red | `mcp_edit_operation_sets_the_turning_picks_and_undo_clears_them` |
| the Threading reason | red | `threading_keeps_its_start_law_and_says_so_by_name` |
| the early return for no pick | red | `no_pick_gives_the_path_back_unchanged` |
| the in-air law | red | `each_law_refuses_by_name` |
| start rapid crosses the stock | red | `a_rapid_through_the_bar_is_refused_by_name` |
| start feed clearance | red | `each_law_refuses_by_name` |
| exit feed clearance | red | `each_law_refuses_by_name` |
| exit lift law | red | `each_law_refuses_by_name` |
| canned cycle / compensation guard | red | `a_path_with_a_canned_cycle_takes_no_pick` |
| arc pass kept whole | red | `an_arc_pass_stays_whole` |
| all guards put back | green | - |

Gates:

- `cargo xtask gate quick --base upstream/main` (base `97a676e5c`): 232 steps. 231 were green. The one red step was `ui suites: lib`, in a new test of this PR (the Threading fixture had the wrong insert). I fixed the fixture and ran the step again: 1651 passed, 0 failed.
- After that run I changed only test code (the fixture and one type alias for clippy). I ran `app suites: start_exit_shared` again: 12 passed.
- `cargo clippy -p camcraft-motion -p camcraft-app -p camcraft-ui --all-targets -- -D warnings`: clean.
- `cargo xtask gate light`: 6 steps, 0 failed.
- `cargo xtask gate heavy --base upstream/main`, targeted: `motion heavy: lib`, `app heavy: start_exit_shared`, `app heavy: lathe_field_sim`, `app heavy: lathe_workholding_kinds`. 4 steps, 0 failed.

## Goldens moved

None. No `*.nc`, `*.cl` or `examples/catalog/**` file is in the diff.

These golden suites ran and are green with no file change:

- `example_catalog`, `example_catalog_adaptive`, `example_catalog_edge_work` (in the quick gate);
- `lathe_post`, `lathe_post_tormach`, `lathe_post_inch`, `lathe_post_css`, `lathe_cycle_exit`, `golden_cl`;
- the turning suites of the quick gate (`turning`, `turning_profile`, `turning_face_approach`, `turning_face_seed` and the others).

`with_picks` returns the path before it reads a number when there is no pick. `no_pick_gives_the_path_back_unchanged` pins this.

## Not exercised

- The full heavy lanes. The dry run of `cargo xtask gate heavy --base upstream/main` gives 108 release steps, because `generate.rs` is in the diff. I ran the 4 steps that hold turning code. AGENTS.md "Heavy lanes at review" gives a `P2` PR no heavy step; the full lanes run at the cut.
- Screenshots of the new UI groups. This run is headless and has no display. The structural tests assert the labels, the rows and the Apply / undo behaviour.
- The posted G-code text of a program with a pick. The tests read the toolpath moves. The posts read the same moves.
- A turning axis that is not on the model origin, and a lathe with a sub-spindle.
- The exit feed against stock that the operation did not cut. The law checks the part and its stock to leave only. The decision file says this.
- The eight other turning kinds. They keep the "owed" row.

## Overlaps

No open PR changes the same function body. These open PRs of the start and exit series change the same files in other arms or lines. The PR that merges second takes `git merge origin/main`.

- #3980 (Sinker): `pick_kinds.rs`, `mcp/tools.rs`, `start_exit_shared.rs`, `op_page.rs`.
- #3978 (Slot): `pick_kinds.rs`, `generate.rs`, `start_exit_shared.rs`.
- #3970 (Drill, Bore, Thread): `pick_kinds.rs`, `generate.rs`, `mcp/tools.rs`, `start_exit_shared.rs`, `op_page.rs`.
- #3957 (Wire Contour): `pick_kinds.rs`, `mcp/tools.rs`, `start_exit_shared.rs`.

Each of them adds an arm to `KindInfo::pick`, a variant line to `PickCapability::takes`, a line to `s_edit_op` and a case to `every_kind_has_one_pick_capability_and_only_the_taken_ones_take_a_pick`. A merge must keep the two sides.

#3832, #3674 and #3103 change other arms of `generate.rs`. #3963 changes a different function of `mcp/tools.rs`.

New test files: the app tests are a submodule of the existing `start_exit_shared` binary. No new top-level test binary.

Effort: high

Changelog: Turning: Facing, Profile Rough and Profile Finish take a start point and an exit point in the lathe (Z, X) plane; a point that the laws cannot hold is refused by name.
